description:
A Fleet Testing Mod

Console Commands and MagicLib recommended!

Safe to add to existing saves, and safe to remove from existing saves

Mod details

This mod introduces target practice variants of vanilla ships to the simulator, provides two main menu missions for fleet/station versus fleet tests, adds several Console Commands commands that help with testing fleets in the campaign, and includes test-only MagicBounties in Asharu featuring [REDACTED] fleets. Nothing else too fancy; this is just to make it easier for people to theorycraft and test out their ships or fleets, especially against the current vanilla end-game enemies.

List of commands
To see all the commands added by this mod in-game, type 'help fleettesting' into the Console Commands prompt.
AddMaxRandomDMods - Applies the maximum number of d-mods to all ships in the player fleet. Does not include any d-mods that only appear on destroyed ships, like Structural Damage. Can specifiy a hull ID to only add d-mods to matching player ships.
AddPresetOfficers - Adds a number of preset officers to the player fleet. If no arguments are entered, lists all available preset officer IDs. Preset officer IDs and configurations can be modified in AFleetTestingMod/data/config/presetOfficers.json.
AddSMods - Applies specified s-mods to all player ships matching a specified hull ID. Can specify any number of hullmods to s-mod at once.
ClearAllDMods - Clears all d-mods from all ships in the player fleet, restoring them to pristine condition. Can specifiy a hull ID to only remove d-mods from matching player ships.
ClearAllSMods - Clears all s-mods from all ships in the player fleet. Can specifiy a hull ID to only remove s-mods from matching player ships.
InitiateFleetTest - Sets up the player fleet for fleet testing, removes all current ships and officers, and teleports the player to the Abandoned Terraforming Platform in Corvus. If MagicLib is enabled, also allows the test-only Remnant Ordo MagicBounties to appear.
ShowExceptionalPodOfficers - Shows the location of all exceptional pod officers in this sector.
ShowFleetStats - Shows fleet stats for fleets within the current location. If no arguments are entered, defaults to showing the fleet stats for the player fleet.
ShowHullIDs - Shows the hull IDs of all ships in the player fleet.
ShowPlayerDMods - Shows all d-mods and their distribution within the player fleet.
SpawnDwellerFleets - Spawns a number of Shrouded Dweller manifestations. Size of the manifestation varies based on the specified strength.
SpawnFactionFleets - Spawns a number of faction fleets with the specified patrol type or base combat fleet points (FP). Uses stats from the faction's best market or, if the faction has no markets, a fake market with base 95% ship quality and ~383% fleet size. Also supports additional options.
SpawnRemnantStation - Spawns a Remnant station on the player fleet's location. This station generates a specified number of fleets with a specified initial Fleet Points. Also sets player's relationship with Remnants to Inhospitable. If no arguments are entered, initial FP for spawned fleets is 128 and max number of fleets is 10.
SpawnThreatFleets - Spawns a number of Threat strike fleets, where the Threat fleet composition depends on the specified abyssal depth and the number of existing Second/Third Strike fleets within a star system (including those that will be spawned via this command). The player must be in a star system for the command to work.
